ref: a public reel on writing a good script (reference, not shipped)
units: seconds; *_h and box values are fractions of frame height/width; colours sampled from the ref frames (JPEG means, +-6 per channel)

section.why: one section per sentence (ANALIZ §1): a sentence under min_s joins the next, one over max_s splits at its longest pause; a scroll needs ≥ 0.7 s to settle (objects.O.scroll) so min_s keeps two changes apart

recap.why: the whole document returns at 51 s as the recap (ANALIZ §1)

head.why: the document sits BEHIND the speaker: his head occludes the bars (ref 3.3 s, 43.9-44.2 s); a person cut-out is needed wherever a bar crosses the head

document.why: measured on ref-a (52.2 s, 1080x1920, 30 fps): one section per sentence; title letters rise and fade on a stagger; neon bars wipe in left to right on their clause; the document scrolls up between sections; captions small white at a fixed seat, hard cut per phrase; the whole document returns as a recap near the end

caption.look: white semibold grotesk, thin soft shadow, no box, hard cut per phrase, never moves

camera.framing: one locked take; jump cuts keep the framing
camera.measured_zooms: see hareket.json (3.07 per 10 s, median 3.06 %, 0.667 s)

transitions: hard jump cuts only, breaths removed
